title: AI Token Spend
description: Monthly AI token spend estimator and cross-model comparator: per-model monthly cost, cost per request, the component breakdown, and a cheapest-first ranking, priced from a dated price table by an as_of date. Integer USD micros per million tokens with an overflow-safe floor-split cost formula. Refuses ambiguous price entries, missing component prices and cap overruns with named reasons. Prices are an input, never kernel constants: the default is the dated 2026-10-04 provider-page snapshot.

as_of.description: Pricing date, a real calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD. The node reads no clock; an entry applies when effective_from <= as_of <= effective_through.

usage.description: Requests per month, input and output tokens per request, cached-input and batch/long-context shares in bp, cache-write tokens with a 5m or 1h TTL.

price_table.description: Dated snapshot: snapshot_verified_on, currency USD, unit usd_micros_per_million_tokens, and models[] with tier, effective dates and micros prices.

compare.description: Model names to price and rank, cheapest first; ties break by the model string.

output_schema.description: output_payload: as_of, snapshot_verified_on, snapshot_age_days, results[]{provider, model, tier, monthly_micros, per_request_micros, components{input, cached_input, cache_write, output}, price_entry_source_sha256}, ranking[model...], cheapest, refusals[]{provider, model, code, text}, refusal_reason, domain_errors[], scope_note.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads: as_of, usage, price_table, compare.
author: PostOakLabs

output_example.scope_note: No taxes or regional uplift; no image, audio or video tokens; no tool-use surcharges; no tiered volume discounts; and no subscription or committed-spend deals. Prices come from the dated price_table input — the default snapshot is a capture of the official provider price pages verified on its own snapshot_verified_on date, never a live quote.
